title: Predator 3500 Watt Super Quiet Inverter Generator
source_facts:
The Predator 3500 Watt Super Quiet Inverter Generator is perfect for those needing a portable and quiet power solution. Powered by a 212cc Predator engine, this generator delivers 3500 max starting watts and 3000 max running watts, making it ideal for RVs, camping, tailgating, and powering sensitive electronics. It uses pure sine wave inverter technology, ensuring clean power for electronics like smartphones, laptops, and TVs.

 With a 2.3-gallon fuel tank, the generator offers up to 11 hours of runtime at 25% load, making it perfect for long-lasting power needs without constant refueling. Its SUPER QUIET™ enclosure keeps noise levels at a mere 56 dBA, which is comparable to the sound of a quiet conversation.

 This inverter generator is also built with CO SECURE™ technology, which automatically shuts the unit down if dangerous carbon monoxide levels are detected, keeping you and your surroundings safe. It’s compact and lightweight, with smooth-rolling wheels for easy portability, and comes with an RV adapter for hassle-free use.

source_facts:

title: Toro TimeMaster 21199 30 in. 223 cc Gas Self-Propelled Lawn Mower
source_facts:
Tackle large yards with ease using the Toro TimeMaster 21199 30-inch Gas Self-Propelled Lawn Mower. Designed for speed, power, and efficiency, this mower features a 223 cc Briggs & Stratton OHV engine, allowing you to cut a wider path in fewer passes. The Dual-Force™ cutting system and Toro Atomic blades deliver a superior mulch, ensuring a lush, healthy lawn.

 With Personal Pace® technology, you control the mowing speed for a comfortable and efficient mowing experience. The Spin-Stop™ feature lets you step away without restarting, while the Quick Stow Storage Handle allows for compact storage and adjustable height positions. The washout port makes cleaning the undercarriage quick and easy.

 Key Features:

 ✅ Powerful 223 cc Briggs & Stratton OHV Engine – Built for high-performance cutting

 ✅ 30-inch Cutting Width – Covers more ground in less time

 ✅ Dual-Force™ Cutting System with Atomic Blades – Produces a fine mulch for a healthier lawn

 ✅ Personal Pace® Self-Propelled System – Automatically adjusts to your walking speed

 ✅ Spin-Stop™ Blade Stop System – Stops the blade without shutting off the engine, so you can step away when needed

 ✅ 2-Point Height-of-Cut Adjustment – Easily adjust deck height for customized mowing

 ✅ Quick Stow Storage Handle – Two storage positions for compact and convenient storage

 ✅ Washout Port – Easily clean the underside of the mower deck with a garden hose

 ✅ 3-Year Full Warranty & 3-Year Guaranteed-to-Start Warranty – Reliable performance backed by Toro

 🌱 Get the job done faster with the Toro TimeMaster 30-inch Lawn Mower—the perfect choice for large yards and busy schedules!
